description: This file defines the AutoTextImpl class, which implements the AutoText interface. It manages a trie-based data structure for storing and looking up corrections for frequent misspellings, loading data from an XML resource, and providing lookup functionality.

classes.name: AutoTextImpl
classes.description: Implements a dictionary of corrections to frequent misspellings using a trie data structure, loaded from XML resources.

methods.name: AutoTextImpl
methods.description: Constructor that loads the dictionary data from an XML resource and initializes the trie structure.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Looks up a source string in the trie and returns the corrected text if available.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a source string and its offset to the trie structure.

methods.name: newTrieNode
methods.description: Creates a new node in the trie, expanding the array if necessary.
